interview.name: Gus
interview.answer: The repair drive is still being coordinated, but no time or location is given in these notes.

reflections: Gus is dependable and steps up to coordinate supplies and details for the repair drive.
Tess and Pia are both acting as helpful organizers, tracking needs and preventing missing items.

Gus is the central organizer who reliably offers concrete help and clearly states what tools he will bring.
Pia and Rey coordinate by checking inventory gaps, while Gus adjusts his contribution based on what is still needed.
Bo focuses on prioritizing the most urgent repair tasks and keeping others informed about additional issues.
Gus is consistently reliable and proactive about bringing tools and keeping the group updated.
Rey is coordinating the repair drive logistics by checking the list and preventing duplicate supplies.
The group communicates collaboratively and politely, with repeated confirmation that missing items will be checked before more gear is added.
Gus is consistently dependable and proactive about bringing the right tools, then follows up by keeping his bag ready for changes.
The group coordinates well by checking lists and supplies to avoid duplicate gear and missing items.
Gus adapts easily to different contacts (Rey, Jules, Cleo, Ira) and stays responsive to updates about the repair drive.
Gus is consistently reliable and proactive, especially around the repair drive, and others trust him to keep equipment ready or fill gaps.
The group is coordinating by sharing updates and checking who can bring what, which suggests a practical, task-focused relationship with clear handoffs.
Ira and Kira act as status-check or coordination points, while Dane is still getting oriented but wants to contribute where needed.
